description: This file contains core routing logic for FastAPI, including definitions of route classes, middleware, dependency injection mechanisms, and utility functions for handling HTTP and WebSocket requests within FastAPI applications.

classes.name: APIWebSocketRoute
classes.description: Custom WebSocket route class for FastAPI supporting dependencies and advanced configuration.

classes.name: APIRoute
classes.description: Represents an individual API route with all associated metadata, including path, endpoint, response models, and dependencies.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: A router class to organize routes, support prefixing, tags, dependencies, and nested routers for FastAPI applications.
